title: MonsterAction
description: Terratopia monster action definition (src/GameEngine/DataClasses/MonsterAction.cs). Note: if targetingType is "All" or "Self", allowMultipleAttackOnSameTarget must be omitted — enforced at load time by ContentLoader, not expressible here.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version this file was written against. Managed by the GameData Editor — do not hand-edit.

monsterActionId.description: Unique identifier for this monster action.

keywords.description: Names of keyword classes (src/CombatEngine/Keywords) applied to this action, e.g. "Engage". Hand-maintained against PowerKeywordRegistry.cs's registered KeywordName constants — keep in sync by hand.

allowMultipleAttackOnSameTarget.description: Must be omitted when targetingType is "All" or "Self".

combatFunction.description: Name of the CombatFunction class (src/CombatEngine/CombatFunctions) that resolves this entire action - damage, healing, statuses, bespoke effects. Hand-maintained against CombatFunctionRegistry.cs's registered FunctionName constants - keep in sync by hand. An unregistered name throws at combat time.

parameters.description: Closed, hand-maintained superset of every parameter any CombatFunction reads (mirrors CombatFunctionParameters.cs). Every field is optional here; each function validates the ones it requires and defaults the rest.

element.description: BasicDamage: optional. Omit for a non-elemental (physical) hit.

calcType.description: BasicDamage/BasicHeal: optional. FixedPower uses powerFactor as the raw action power (still scaled by Level and mitigated by Defense), ignoring the actor's Power stat. FixedAmount uses powerFactor as the entire base amount, ignoring both Power and Level; Defense still mitigates it normally. PercentOfMax uses powerFactor as a fraction of the target's MaxHp (e.g. 0.2 = 20%) as the entire base amount, ignoring Power and Level; Defense still mitigates it normally for BasicDamage.

buffsDebuffs.description: BasicDamage/BasicHeal: optional. Timed buffs/debuffs, each applied once after the action fully resolves — after all hits, and regardless of what was evaded. At most one entry per stat+target combination.

type.description: Positive raises the stat by gameSettings.timedBuffPct, Negative lowers it by the same fraction. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.Enums.BuffDebuffType.

target.description: Who this entry lands on, relative to the actor and independent of the action's own targets. SelectedTargets is the action's chosen targets, de-duplicated. RandomAlly excludes the actor. All selectors consider living entities only. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.Enums.BuffDebuffTarget.

rounds.description: Rounds it lasts, counted down at the start of each round. Re-applying the same type adds to the remaining rounds; the opposite type cancels it out. Ignored when untilRemoved is true.

untilRemoved.description: When true, this entry never expires from the round clock and rounds is ignored — it stays active until an opposite-polarity application on the same stat cancels it. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.DataClasses.BuffDebuffSpec.

cancelOnEntityDeath.description: When true, this entry is removed the moment the afflicted entity dies, before EntityDeath is raised, and never survives a later Revive. When false, it's left in place through death. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.DataClasses.BuffDebuffSpec.

cancelOnApplierDeath.description: When true, this entry is removed the moment the entity that applied it dies, even if the afflicted entity is someone else and stays alive. When false, it outlives its applier. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.DataClasses.BuffDebuffSpec.

regensDrains.description: BasicDamage/BasicHeal: optional. Timed regen/drain, each applied once after the action fully resolves. Heals or damages the target's Hp or Tp by a fixed percentage of its max at the start of every round, with no elemental component. At most one entry per stat+target combination.

type.description: Positive heals/restores gameSettings.regenDrainHpPct or regenDrainTpPct of the resource's max each round, Negative deals/spends the same fraction. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.Enums.RegenDrainType.

target.description: Who this entry lands on, relative to the actor and independent of the action's own targets. SelectedTargets is the action's chosen targets, de-duplicated. RandomAlly excludes the actor. All selectors consider living entities only. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.Enums.BuffDebuffTarget (shared with buffsDebuffs).

rounds.description: Rounds it lasts. The heal/damage is applied at the start of each round, before the remaining rounds are counted down. Re-applying the same type adds to the remaining rounds; the opposite type cancels it out. Ignored when untilRemoved is true.

untilRemoved.description: When true, this entry never expires from the round clock and rounds is ignored — it stays active until an opposite-polarity application on the same stat cancels it. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.DataClasses.RegenDrainSpec.

cancelOnEntityDeath.description: When true, this entry is removed the moment the afflicted entity dies, before EntityDeath is raised, and never survives a later Revive. When false, it's left in place through death. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.DataClasses.RegenDrainSpec.

cancelOnApplierDeath.description: When true, this entry is removed the moment the entity that applied it dies, even if the afflicted entity is someone else and stays alive. When false, it outlives its applier. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.DataClasses.RegenDrainSpec.

triggeredEffectsApplied.description: BasicDamage/BasicHeal: optional. Triggered effects granted once after the action fully resolves — after all hits, and regardless of what was evaded. Granting a triggered effect an entity already owns is a no-op. At most one entry per triggeredEffect+target combination.

triggeredEffect.description: Hand-maintained against TriggeredEffectRegistry.cs's registered TriggeredEffectName constants (same enum as monster.schema.json's triggeredEffects).

target.description: Who this entry lands on, relative to the actor and independent of the action's own targets. SelectedTargets is the action's chosen targets, de-duplicated. RandomAlly excludes the actor. All selectors consider living entities only. Hand-maintained against CombatEngine.Enums.BuffDebuffTarget (shared with buffsDebuffs/regensDrains).
